name: unemployed-sk
description: unemployed.sk — Tinder-style career platform for Gen Z in Slovakia

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/app dist/employer && cp -r apps/landing/* dist/ && (cd apps/student && npm install && npm run build) && cp -r apps/student/dist/* dist/app/ && (cd apps/employer && npm install && npm run build) && cp -r apps/employer/dist/* dist/employer/ && cp _redirects dist/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:student && npm run build:employer
scripts.postinstall: cd apps/student && npm install && cd ../employer && npm install
